text:
maria: Heads-up — customers reported runtime failures after the embed-frame header rename. Their SDKs send 'meta-v2' but workers expect 'x-meta'. Where do we put a short-lived shim?
jon: Do we have a repro payload?
alex: Got one from acme-prod (sanitized). It's a header rename inside a streaming envelope, not token bytes.
maria: This matters for low-latency routes — parsing add cost.
ryan: Options: 1) ingress router translates frames to x-meta; 2) runtime accepts both keys; 3) per-tenant sidecar normalizes frames. Edge cheap for worker CPU but adds router work; worker change touches hot path; sidecar operationally heavier.
sara: For Dedicated/private, sidecar onboarding is less scary.
jon: For hosted tenants, ingress-per-tenant flag seems fastest. We can gate it in the routing table and enable only for affected customers.
alex: Benchmark note: naive frame parse in router adds ~200us p99 for short responses. That could affect 50ms SLOs.
ryan: Mitigation: lazy pattern match — only inspect frames that contain the header prefix bytes. Also gate per-tenant.
sara: Sidecar should be an infra template for private customers to opt into while we ship runtime fixes.
ci-bot: deploy-check: routing table must support per-tenant boolean flag; rollout at 1%, 10%, 50%, 100% with 24h windows.
maria: Proposal: implement lightweight ingress pattern-matching translation behind a per-tenant flag as immediate mitigation. Parallel: add runtime support for both keys as permanent compatibility.
jon: Two-stage plan LGTM. Telemetry required: shim_applied (bool), shim_latency_ms, tenant_flag_origin.
alex: Draft pseudocode for router handler:
```
// router frame handler
if (frame.startsWithHeaderPrefix()) {
  if (frame.headers.contains("meta-v2")) {
    frame.headers.set("x-meta", frame.headers.get("meta-v2"));
    frame.headers.remove("meta-v2");
  }
}
```
ryan: Add unit tests for streaming frames and property-based fuzzing for malformed frames. Fail build if parsing errors > 0.1% during canary.
sara: I'll prepare sidecar template and migration doc for Dedicated/private customers.
maria: Action items: alex -> edge shim PR with lazy match; jon -> routing flag + canary plan; ryan -> runtime dual-key acceptance spec + tests; sara -> sidecar template + docs.
ci-bot: tickets created: INFRA-4821 (edge shim), RUNTIME-923 (dual-key acceptance), OPS-312 (canary plan).
maria: Timeline: edge shim + small canary today, runtime patch next week, sidecar templates within 2 weeks. Notify CSMs for impacted tenants. :eyes:
